mapper.select: SELECT m.moment_id AS momentId, m.moment_title AS momentTitle, m.moment_category AS momentCategory, m.moment_content AS momentContent, m.moment_certified AS momentCertified, m.moment_comment_status AS momentCommentStatus, m.moment_like AS momentLike, m.moment_view AS momentView, l.location_name AS locationName, l.address AS address, mem.member_nickname AS memberNickname, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_moment m JOIN tb_location l ON m.location_id = l.location_id JOIN tb_member mem ON m.member_id = mem.member_id WHERE m.moment_id = #{momentId} AND m.moment_status = true
